=== rate-limit
A token bucket refills at a fixed rate, and each request takes a token.
When it is empty, the rate limit answers 429.
The glossary lists every term; this section is a heading id, not a term id.
A burst spends the tokens saved up while the client was idle.
Why a bucket
It smooths traffic without a queue.
